title: Separate computational content (what) from mechanism (how)
hypothesis: A shared linear computation tensor addressed by separate what and how codes generalizes to heldout cross-products with fewer complete bytes than independent pair operators and better than native tensor factorization.

world.teacher: shared core plus rank-2 tensor-product what×how operator residual

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after exact native tensor-factor alias or storage/quality gate miss.

success_gate: heldout nRMSE <=0.02, >=25% fewer bytes than independent, and strict quality/byte advantage over native CP factorization.
failure_gate: FAIL if native CP exactly matches Mirror or quality/storage gate misses.
